neighbours.label: the point where a second spelling variant of a just-mentioned name diverges from the first (userId … user_id, capitalisation … capitalization)
fire: The API reference says orderId, yet every table in the warehouse calls it order_id.
Older files in the repository use account_id, while the newer services send accountId.
The British edition prints organisation where the American one prints organization.
Her thesis used the word globalisation, which the publisher changed to globalization.
The JSON payload has a key named productId, but the SQL column is product_id.
In the style guide the verb is spelled realise, though the press office writes realize.
The legacy client expects session_id, and the mobile app sends sessionId.
Canadian papers often write civilisation where American papers write civilization.
quiet: The API reference lists every field in the order table along with its type.
Older files in the repository use tabs, while the newer services use spaces.
The British edition has a longer preface than the American one.
Her thesis used the word globalization on nearly every page.
The JSON payload has a key named product_id that holds an integer.
In the style guide the verb realize is listed under common errors.
The legacy client expects a token, and the mobile app sends a cookie.
Canadian papers often cover hockey where American papers cover baseball.

notes: Card: tenantId/tenant_id, vn_id/vnId, capitalisation/capitalization, ATel #/ATel#, Amedeo/Amédée. Probes: variant pairs 0.22-0.43, a lone client_id 0.00, Köln/Cologne 0.12. Weak pole (fires at 0.2-0.4 of max), so the median may fall short.
